title: sEMG session manifest row
description: CSV rows normalized to typed values: blank optional fields become null, boolean strings become booleans, numeric sample rates become numbers. Gesture sets retain their pipe-delimited CSV representation. Detailed experimental conditions are optional for legacy sessions.

gesture_set.description: Exact labels separated by |, including rest.

posture.description: Existing coarse posture identifier, preserved without mapping it to detailed conditions.

shoulder_position.description: Observed condition or measured angle with units; no inferred legacy angles.

elbow_position.description: Observed condition or measured angle with units.

calibration_session_id.description: Session whose calibration/model would be used; does not itself define an evaluation split.

posture_set.description: Pipe-delimited static blocks present; each v2 sample/trial carries its actual arm_posture.

gesture_set_id.description: Preset name, such as dataset_v2_9class; gesture_set retains the exact pipe-delimited class labels.
